figures.before: What Makes Dental Office Construction Different From Standard Medical Office
figures.alt: Unoccupied dental treatment room under fit-out with metal studs, gypsum board, electrical conduit, plumbing rough-ins, and a partial ceiling grid
figures.caption: Dental treatment rooms concentrate equipment, utility rough-ins, clearances, controls, finishes, ceiling systems, and vendor requirements in a compact clinical space.

figures.before: Scope of a Standard Jacksonville Dental Office Build-Out
figures.alt: Commercial restroom under construction with accessible clearances, wall backing, plumbing rough-ins, and metal-stud framing
figures.caption: The build-out scope needs to connect treatment rooms with support areas, accessible restrooms, circulation, services, finishes, inspections, and the operational needs of the practice.

figures.alt: Construction planning table with drawings, measuring tools, a blank clipboard, and coordination materials
figures.caption: Early vendor coordination gives the construction team the information needed for equipment locations, supports, utilities, clearances, installation dates, testing, and final turnover.
